title: MASQUE population estimates artifact
description: The contract between the offline, design-aware survey estimation step and the ResearchReadinessPanel. The panel RENDERS this file; it never computes it. See README_DATA_CONNECTION.md for why that separation is not negotiable.

masqueArtifact.description: Marker the panel keys on to tell an estimates artifact apart from a cohort row file.

producedBy.description: Script and version that produced this, e.g. 'masque_population_etl.R 0.1.0 / R survey 4.4-2'. Required for the §8 reproducibility check.

sha256.description: Hash of the file as downloaded. Without it the estimate is not reproducible.

design.description: The design specification actually used. Present so a reader can verify the estimate is design-aware rather than a naive weighted mean.

domainAnalysis.description: True if subpopulation estimates were produced by subsetting the DESIGN (subset()) rather than the data frame. Filtering rows before building the design breaks variance estimation; this flag exists so a reviewer can check it was done correctly.

phenotype.description: The §7.1 computable phenotype as applied, in enough detail to re-derive it.

variableMap.description: Concept -> survey variable, from the mapping file.

unmapped.description: Concepts the chosen cycle cannot express. NEVER silently dropped — a phenotype missing its vestibular component is a different phenotype and the panel must say so.

estimates.description: One entry per reported quantity. Every entry carries an interval and an unweighted denominator; a point estimate with neither is not reportable.

domain.description: Subgroup, e.g. 'sex=female'. Omit for the total.

df.description: Design degrees of freedom — strata minus PSUs, not sample size.

rse.description: Relative standard error. NCHS presentation standards suppress estimates above a threshold; the panel honours the suppress flag rather than deciding for itself.

suppress.description: Set by the ETL per the steward's own presentation standard. The panel shows the cell as suppressed and never prints the value.

caveats.description: Rendered verbatim by the panel beneath the numbers. This is where 'screening-level, not diagnosed prevalence' lives.
